attribution.author: Gloria Willcox
attribution.note: Labels and pairings transcribed from the original 1982 Feeling Wheel. Historical wording is preserved; colors and interface are contemporary adaptations. Descriptions are contemporary editorial explanations, not Willcox’s original definitions.

categories.label: Mad

children.label: Hurt
Jealous
children.description: Feeling uneasy about losing attention, affection, or a valued connection.
Feeling emotionally wounded by something that happened or was said.

children.label: Hostile
Selfish
children.description: Feeling focused on your own wants with little consideration for others’ needs.
Feeling unfriendly, defensive, or ready to oppose someone or something.

children.label: Angry
Frustrated
children.description: Feeling upset because something important is being blocked or delayed.
Feeling strong displeasure about an obstacle, injury, or perceived unfairness.

children.label: Rage
Furious
children.description: Feeling extremely angry about something that has happened or seems wrong.
Feeling anger so intense that it seems difficult to contain.

children.label: Hateful
Irritated
children.description: Feeling bothered or unsettled by something that strains your patience.
Feeling intense dislike or hostility toward someone or something.

children.label: Critical
Skeptical
children.description: Feeling doubtful or unconvinced, with a wish for clearer reasons or evidence.
Feeling inclined to notice faults or question what seems wrong.

categories.description: Feeling upset or angry about something that matters to you.

categories.label: Scared

children.label: Rejected
Bewildered
children.description: Feeling lost or unsettled because something unexpected is difficult to understand.
Feeling unwanted, excluded, or turned away by someone whose acceptance matters.

children.label: Confused
Discouraged
children.description: Feeling less hopeful or motivated after a setback or difficult experience.
Feeling unsure how to understand something or make sense of it.

children.label: Helpless
Insignificant
children.description: Feeling overlooked or as though your presence and needs do not matter.
Feeling unable to influence what is happening or change an unwanted situation.

children.label: Submissive
Weak
children.description: Feeling short of the strength, energy, or resolve you would like.
Feeling inclined to yield to someone else’s wishes or authority.

children.label: Insecure
Foolish
children.description: Feeling embarrassed about a choice or worried that it showed poor judgment.
Feeling unsure of your worth, abilities, place, or support from others.

children.label: Anxious
Embarrassed
children.description: Feeling uncomfortable or exposed because of how you think others see you.
Feeling uneasy, tense, or worried about what might happen next.

categories.description: Feeling frightened or uneasy about a possible danger or threat.

categories.label: Joyful

children.label: Excited
Daring
children.description: Feeling willing to take a risk or try something unfamiliar.
Feeling eager and energized by something happening or about to happen.

children.label: Sexy
Fascinating
children.description: Feeling interesting, engaging, or able to hold someone else’s attention.
Feeling attractive, desirable, or connected to your own sensuality.

children.label: Energetic
Stimulating
children.description: Engaging or exciting in a way that stirs interest, thought, or energy.
Feeling lively and ready to move, participate, or take something on.

children.label: Playful
Amused
children.description: Feeling entertained or finding humor and lightness in something.
Feeling lighthearted and open to fun, humor, or spontaneous expression.

children.label: Creative
Extravagant
children.description: Feeling expressive or indulgent, with a wish to go beyond ordinary limits.
Feeling drawn to imagine possibilities or make something in your own way.

children.label: Aware
Delightful
children.description: Feeling pleasantly lighthearted, enjoyable, or able to bring happiness to others.
Feeling attentive to your experience, surroundings, or what is happening within you.

categories.description: Feeling a strong sense of happiness, pleasure, or delight in the moment.

categories.label: Powerful

children.label: Proud
Cheerful
children.description: Feeling bright, upbeat, and ready to meet the moment with good spirits.
Feeling pleased with an effort, achievement, quality, or connection that matters.

children.label: Respected
Satisfied
children.description: Feeling that a need, wish, or expectation has been met.
Feeling that others recognize your dignity, perspective, or abilities.

children.label: Appreciated
Valuable
children.description: Feeling that your presence, qualities, or contributions have value.
Feeling that someone notices and values your presence or contribution.

children.label: Hopeful
Worthwhile
children.description: Feeling that you or your efforts have meaning and value.
Feeling that something good or meaningful may still be possible.

children.label: Important
Intelligent
children.description: Feeling capable of understanding, learning, or making sense of something.
Feeling that you matter and have a meaningful place in others’ lives.

children.label: Faithful
Confident
children.description: Feeling able to trust yourself or handle what is ahead.
Feeling steady in your loyalty, trust, or commitment to someone or something.

categories.description: Feeling able to act, influence events, or make a meaningful difference.

categories.label: Peaceful

children.label: Nurturing
Thankful
children.description: Feeling gratitude for something received, experienced, or made possible.
Feeling drawn to care for, support, or help someone grow.

children.label: Trusting
Sentimental
children.description: Feeling tender emotion around memories, relationships, or things with personal meaning.
Feeling able to rely on someone or something with less guardedness.

children.label: Loving
Serene
children.description: Feeling deeply calm and relatively undisturbed by what is around you.
Feeling warmth, affection, and care toward someone or something.

children.label: Intimate
Responsive
children.description: Feeling receptive and ready to engage with someone or something.
Feeling a close, personal connection in which you can be open.

children.label: Thoughtful
Relaxed
children.description: Feeling less tense and able to settle into the moment.
Feeling reflective or attentive to the meaning of something or someone’s needs.

children.label: Content
Pensive
children.description: Feeling quietly absorbed in reflection, perhaps with a touch of sadness.
Feeling comfortable with what you have or where you are.

categories.description: Feeling a sense of quiet, ease, or freedom from inner conflict.

categories.label: Sad

children.label: Sleepy
Apathetic
children.description: Feeling little interest, concern, or motivation toward things around you.
Feeling drowsy and drawn toward rest or falling asleep.

children.label: Bored
Inferior
children.description: Feeling less capable, valued, or worthy than the people around you.
Feeling under-engaged and wishing for something more interesting or absorbing.

children.label: Lonely
Inadequate
children.description: Feeling that your abilities or resources fall short of what seems needed.
Feeling the absence of the closeness or companionship you want.

children.label: Depressed
Miserable
children.description: Feeling deeply unhappy or weighed down by a painful experience.
Feeling deeply low or discouraged, with little pleasure or hope in the moment.

children.label: Ashamed
Stupid
children.description: Feeling unable to think clearly or doubting your understanding or judgment.
Feeling painfully exposed or negatively judged in your own or others’ eyes.

children.label: Guilty
Bashful
children.description: Feeling shy or self-conscious when attention is directed toward you.
Feeling uneasy or remorseful about something you did or left undone.

categories.description: Feeling sorrow, loss, or a lowering of your usual spirits.
